text:
maria: Heads up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8234 is blocking tonight's canary cut. We need 2x LGTM before 18:00 PT or the cut is delayed. @kevin @dan can you take a look? CI shows an integration flake but unit tests pass. (cutoff ~1h20m)
kevin: On it, will do a full review in ~15m. Ping me if you need an extra pair sooner.
alex: I can hop on this if dan gets swamped. Which test is flaking?
ci-bot: CI started — unit-tests: passed, integration-tests: failed (timeout in test_kv_cache_reconnect), lint: passed
maria: The failing test is `test_kv_cache_reconnect` — reproduces locally sometimes. I bumped the harness timeout from 30s to 45s in the latest push to avoid the intermittent timeout: `tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py: timeout=45`
dan: Rebased onto main and running local smoke. If smoke looks ok I'll trigger r+ after a quick sanity check.
kevin: Quick review notes: small style nit in batching loop (see comment), and one question about error handling in cache reconnect path — behavior looks fine though. I'll approve after nit addressed.
alex: Confirmed behavior locally, CI rerun queued. If kevin is good with the nit, happy to give the second LGTM.
maria: Adding @josh as fallback approver — he's out this afternoon but said he can give a quick +1 if we need it.
dan: Smoke passed locally, re-run of CI triggered (rerun by maria).
ci-bot: CI finished — all checks passed ✅
kevin: LGTM (addressed comment; pushed a tiny formatting fix)
alex: LGTM
maria: Thanks all — merging to canary now and scheduling a small staged rollout at 18:15 PT. Leaving a note in the release doc and pinging oncall.
josh: (react :thumbsup:) Good job catching the flake and moving fast
maria: Noting the coordination here in the postmortem if anything regresses.
